claim: Skills are registered by directory: .agents/skills.json has a single entries item pointing to the skills folder, so a new skill only needs its own SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter.
flow: diff-review skill registration follows the existing folder-based registry.

claim: Existing skills use a YAML frontmatter with name and description fields before the body.
evidence:
REF: /Users/trainguyen/Documents/work/agent/skills/audit-propose-only/SKILL.md:1-7
---
name: audit-propose-only
description: >-
  Read-Only Architectural & Code Audit workflow — investigates codebase/runtime with
  file:line evidence (S2), validates findings via Decision Gate DG3 (laya_gate.py),
  and produces gap analysis or audit reports while strictly prohibiting any code edits
  until explicit User APPROVE.
flow: diff-review SKILL.md will reuse the same frontmatter shape.

claim: Mode A gate rejects a claims batch unless it has at least 2 control_false and at least 1 control_true entries.
evidence:
REF: /Users/trainguyen/Documents/work/agent/tooling/laya_gate.py:283-286
    f_cnt = sum(1 for c in claims if str(c.get("kind") or c.get("type") or "").startswith("control_false"))
    t_cnt = sum(1 for c in claims if str(c.get("kind") or c.get("type") or "").startswith("control_true"))
    if f_cnt < 2 or t_cnt < 1:
        return False, [], f"Need >=2 control_false (got {f_cnt}) and >=1 control_true (got {t_cnt})"
flow: diff-review R5 step must build claims with the required control counts.
